services.name: trial lesson
services.desc: Registration for the upcoming Fall semester is open! We hope you will consider re-registering to continue your musical journey. We offer a variety of music lessons for all ages and levels, including piano, guitar, violin, voice, and more. Our experienced teachers will help you further develop your musical skills and creativity. If you're not a current student or are looking to add an instrument to your repertoire, please fill out the New Student Inquiry Form and we'll get you set up with your free trial lesson!
